what_the_new_files_establish.score_file_convention: import_abcde_datasets.py: scores = np.loadtxt('<name>-score.txt'); nodes relabelled by enumerate(sorted(G.nodes())); so score row i is the node with the i-th smallest integer id. analyse_c3_benchmarks.load_edges relabels by np.unique (sorted) and reads the score file with np.loadtxt in row order - the same convention. Previously supported only indirectly (len(score)==n gate, directional zero-rule pass); now established directly.
what_the_new_files_establish.score_length_mismatch: BRAVA warns and pads the graph with isolated nodes when the score file is longer than the node set; our gate FAILS the graph instead. Conservative; the branch never fired on the five ABCDE graphs (all len(score)==n).
what_the_new_files_establish.edge_reading: nx.read_edgelist(..., create_using=nx.Graph()) - undirected, duplicate edges collapse, self-loops retained by networkx. Our build_csr symmetrises; whether self-loops are dropped there is a separate question not re-opened here.
